FLAG_sectors_do_not_tile_rwanda.finding: District polygons include Rwanda’s Lake Kivu waters; sector polygons exclude them. Away from Kivu the districts are an exact dissolve of their sectors.
FLAG_sectors_do_not_tile_rwanda.evidence: The five Lake Kivu districts (31,32,33,36,37) account for the entire 0.0821116108730742 gap to within 3.5e-17. Controls with large inland lakes — 51 Rwamagana (Muhazi) and 54 Kayonza (Ihema/Mugesera) — match to full double precision.
FLAG_sectors_do_not_tile_rwanda.consequence: A point on Lake Kivu falls inside a district and inside NO sector. A sector-level point-in-polygon resolver must return "no sector" rather than fall through to a nearest match.
FLAG_sectors_do_not_tile_rwanda.handling: Reported, not corrected. Correcting it would be an integrity edit and the licence condition is that integrity is respected.
